title: Geometry, trigonometry and probability repair set (8 questions)
subject: Mathematics
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 97 (Complete the portal geometry and probability repair set (8 questions with mark schemes) and update your repair list.)
intro: Lesson 97 homework. Own 4MA1-style questions. Give circle theorem reasons in words; round lengths to 3 significant figures.

questions.q: The angle at the centre of a circle is 148°. Find the angle at the circumference standing on the same arc. Give a reason. [2]
questions.a: 74° A1; the angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference B1

questions.q: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral. Angle ABC = 97°. Find angle ADC. Give a reason. [2]
questions.a: 83° A1; opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral add up to 180° B1

questions.q: In triangle ABC, b = 8 cm, c = 11 cm and A = 35°. Find a. [3]
In triangle XYZ, XY = 10 cm, angle X = 50° and angle Z = 64°. Find YZ. [3]
questions.a: YZ ÷ sin 50° = 10 ÷ sin 64° M1; YZ = 10 sin 50° ÷ sin 64° M1 = 8.52 cm A1

questions.q: Find the area of a triangle with sides 9 cm and 7 cm and an included angle of 120°. [2]
A bag has 6 red and 4 blue counters. Two are taken without replacement. Find P(both red). [2]
For the same bag, find P(one of each colour). [3]
A cuboid is 5 cm by 4 cm by 3 cm tall. Find (a) the length of its diagonal and (b) the angle the diagonal makes with the base. [4]
